P2_fcy_account.question: Can resident individuals hold a foreign-currency account locally?
P2_fcy_account.answer: Restricted (exchange controls). Residents need permission to open a foreign-currency account with an authorised dealer. The application must give the bank, the currency, the expected balances and why the account is needed. A resident entity qualifies if its activity generates at least US$50,000 a year and it makes regular payments to foreign suppliers; businesses in the Commercial Free Zone or Export Processing Zones qualify automatically (Central Bank of Belize Direction 10/2014, revised December 2014). TRAP for small freelancers: below the US$50,000 level you may not qualify, so expect to convert foreign earnings to BZD.

W1_workarounds.question: Simple, legal routes around payment barriers for a beginner (no misrepresentation, nominees or sanctions evasion)
W1_workarounds.answer: Barriers: Stripe does not accept merchants here; platforms that pay out through PayPal Payouts cannot pay PayPal accounts here (not on PayPal's Payouts list, see P4 for ordinary PayPal receiving); Wise does not let residents hold money. Simple legal routes: (1) Sell digital products or software through a merchant of record: Paddle (software/SaaS only; each seller reviewed), Dodo Payments. The platform is the legal seller to your customers, handles card payments and consumer VAT/sales tax, and pays you out. You still declare the payouts as your income at home (see L3). (2) Sell services on Upwork, which is available here (not on its restricted list). Which withdrawal methods you get (bank, PayPal, Payoneer, etc.) depends on the country and shows in your account. (3) Paid apps and in-app sales through Google Play (merchant registration available here). (4) For direct clients, a bank transfer (SWIFT) into your own local account always works. Follow the local foreign-exchange rules (see P1) and keep invoices. (5) Local official channel: A resident foreign-currency account needs Central Bank permission, applied for through your bank; an entity qualifies at US$50,000 a year of foreign-currency activity. Below that, receive into your BZD account and keep invoices (Central Bank of Belize Direction 10) (P2). Avoid: opening accounts with a foreign address, a relative's or friend's identity, or a VPN to look like you are elsewhere. It breaches platform terms (accounts and funds get frozen) and can break anti-money-laundering or sanctions law.
